cohort: Women in Japan who experienced maternal death related to venous thromboembolism (MD-VTE)
finding: While the overall incidence of MD-VTE in Japan decreased significantly between 1991-1992 and 2010-2013, there was a notable increase in the proportion of MD-VTE cases occurring during pregnancy in the later period.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was found to be more frequently associated with MD-VTE in the study.
